peerMapping.justification: The peer leg uses only single_name_equity symbols from CORE_UNIVERSE, excludes AMD, and has positive weights summing to exactly 1. The construction favors direct compute and AI-accelerator comparability first, then adjacent semiconductor supply-chain exposure, while using the displayed 24-hour perp liquidity in USD millions to avoid outsized weights in thinner names. XYZ100 is used as the one primary index hedge to remove broad Nasdaq technology beta; the single-name peers are intended to leave semiconductor-relative risk rather than replicate the index.

peers.name: NVIDIA
peers.reason: Closest comparator for GPUs and AI accelerators; displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 3.384 USD millions.

peers.name: Intel
peers.reason: Direct x86 CPU competitor and a major semiconductor-cycle reference; displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 6.434 USD millions.

peers.name: Marvell Technology
peers.reason: Data-center interconnect and custom silicon exposure relevant to AI-server builds; displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 1.269 USD millions.

peers.name: Micron Technology
peers.reason: Memory and HBM-cycle sensitivity tied to AI-server demand; displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 11.877 USD millions.

peers.name: Samsung Electronics common
peers.reason: SMSN adds scaled semiconductor exposure across memory, foundry, and logic tied to the AI hardware cycle. Displayed 24-hour perp liquidity of 2.55 USD millions exceeds AMD at 1.18 USD millions, but the memory and foundry mix makes it secondary to compute peers.

peers.name: Cerebras Systems
peers.reason: Cerebras is an AI-accelerator competitor and therefore economically relevant, but its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is only 0.419 USD millions, so it is capped at the smallest peer weight.

primary_index_hedge.name: Nasdaq-100
primary_index_hedge.reason: AMD carries large-cap technology beta, and XYZ100 is an equity_index row for the Nasdaq-100 with displayed 24-hour perp liquidity of 21.944 USD millions. It is preferred to SP500 because it is more technology and semiconductor concentrated, and it is preferred to leveraged ETFs such as SOXL because a 3X product can add path dependence.

peerMapping.historyMethod: daily-rebalanced peer spot total returns using the fixed Kimi weights; unavailable pre-listing peers are omitted and remaining weights renormalized once at least three peers exist; the browser rebases the basket to the target spot level at the first shared date of each selected chart range

liveSplice.method: current TradeXYZ perp mid divided by that peer's TradeXYZ close on its latest spot date; available Kimi weights renormalized and applied as a one-period return from the published peer spot endpoint; USD cash close is retained for disclosure but never mixed with a differently scaled perp contract

earningsOptions.source: Schwab listed-options chain, FMP earnings calendars, and Sharadar adjusted prices

liquidityFilter.sides: OTM puts below spot and OTM calls above spot

model.name: liquid vertical-spread risk-neutral CDF
model.description: Liquid vertical spreads are used when the chain supplies at least four valid probability points; otherwise the nearest liquid ATM straddle supplies the expiration distribution. Earnings-date log distances are time-scaled from the first post-event expiration.
model.measure: risk-neutral, not a historical or physical forecast

historicalAnalysis.eventSource: SEC earnings release history with FMP historical calendar fallback
historicalAnalysis.method: Each current two-leg structure is translated into percentage-of-spot strikes and debit. Those same normalized strikes and today's debit percentage are replayed across prior earnings using the same calendar-day entry lead and post-event exit horizon. A profitable event requires expiration payoff greater than the original debit.
historicalAnalysis.limitation: Stock-path proxy using today's premium; historical option quotes, bid-ask execution, volatility repricing, early exercise, dividends, and transaction costs are not reconstructed.
